source.title: TANUKI: Pon's Summer
source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 7Alcohol ReferenceGamesTANUKI: Pon's Summer Releases 11/10/26VersionNintendo Switch 2EditionDigitalAlcohol ReferenceLoadingTaking place over one sweltering summer...The Tanuki Festival is just a month away, and the shrine is in disrepair. Follow Pon, a well meaning, if a bit lazy Tanuki with a part-time job at the Post Office, as he works to restore the shrine before summer ends. Deliver packages, make friends, and get the shrine ready for the big festival!Taking place over one sweltering summer...Deliver packages Hop on your BMX and deliver letters and packages to the quirky inhabitants of TANUKI’s fictional Japanese island. Packages vary in size, weight, and shape so it'll be up to you to strategise how you approach each delivery.Sushi Chef, Sumo Wrestler, Baseball Pro! As you build up friendship and loyalty with the inhabitants, they'll ask for help with a range of different activities. Take part to unlock items and rewards that will help with the shrine's restoration.The Island Is Your Playground (or Pon'y Hawk!?)Hop on Pon’s BMX and explore the island on two wheels. Launch off ramps, grind along rails, and string together tricks and combos as you discover new paths, radical heights and everything in between. Restore the shrine to former gloryYou've been tasked with getting the Tanuki Shrine ready for the Great Tanuki Matsuri at the end of summer! Turn your earnings from deliveries, activities and over 100 BMX challenges into a shrine you’re proud of: build, upgrade and make it your own. With the Tanuki Festival just around the corner, Pon must restore the shrine to its former glory. Help him earn cash, befriend the local townsfolk, and prep the shrine for the festival of a lifetime.BMX your way into the hearts of all the townsfolk as a mail delivery Tanuki! You've got one month to save up enough to restore the shrine for the Great Tanuki Festival. Deliver packages, compete in sports, make sushi, and much much more in TANUKI!Software description provided by the publisher.About this itemGame file size (estimated)Nintendo Switch: 622 MBNintendo Switch 2: 779 MBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1)Nintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedNintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership. source.title: SONIC PICO PARK
source.evidenceText: SONIC PICO PARKPICO PARK Inc.11/12/2026 08:00 AM UTCAnnouncedAdd to WishlistAdd to WishlistReleases on: 11/12/2026 08:00 AM UTCPS Plus required for online playSupports up to 8 online players with PS PlusOnline play optional1 - 4 players8 online playersAccessibility features (8)Accessibility FeaturesPS Plus required for online playSupports up to 8 online players with PS PlusOnline play optional1 - 4 players8 online playersAccessibility features (8)Accessibility FeaturesAccessibility FeaturesColor AlternativesYou don't need to rely on understanding color to play the game, or important colors can be changed to make them easier to tell apart.Volume ControlsYou can turn down and mute individual audio volumes.Controller Remapping (Basic)You can change the controls to an alternate pre-set layout, or some remapping support is provided.Playable without Motion ControlsYou can play the game without needing to use motion controls.Playable without Touch ControlsYou can play the game without needing to use touch-based controls.Playable without Controller VibrationYou can play the game without turning on controller vibration / haptic feedback.Playable without Adaptive Trigger EffectYou can play the game without the adaptive resistance in the triggers turned on.Quick ChatYou can send and receive pre-set words, phrases, or icons to communicate more easily with other players.Sonic dashes into the world of the hit indie game, PICO PARK!Experience the multiplayer co-op action puzzle gameplay of the PICO PARK series like never before! In our latest entry, the PICO PARK series is teaming up with SEGA's legendary Sonic the Hedgehog!SONIC PICO PARK is a 2D action puzzle game where cooperation is essential!The rules are simple: just reach the goal plate on the right side of each stage. But the only way to succeed is for everyone to work together.This exciting crossover lets every playable character use Sonic's iconic Spin Dash, while adding classic Sonic-style gameplay elements such as rings, loops, and springs! Team up with your friends and take on these new challenges together!Just like the rest of the series, the game supports 2 to 8 players locally or online. All content can be enjoyed with any number of players! Online play also supports cross-play!Combining the flair of Sonic and the puzzle teamwork fun of PICO PARK, this one-of-a-kind collaboration is packed with fun for everyone... whether you experience it with family, friends, your partner, or even new teammates you meet online!Gather your squad and try it today!Release:11/12/2026Publisher:PICO PARK Inc.Genres:Casual©PICO PARK / ©SEGA
